newsitem.title: UK: LME copper holds at easier levels in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper holds at easier levels in late trading.

text.p: LME copper stabilised at weaker levels in late inter-office trading on Monday evening.
At 1800 GMT, three months prices were indicated at $1,920/24, down from an afternoon kerb close of $1,927 per tonne.
Following final business on the kerb, which represented a $6 loss from Friday, prices continued drifting lower. They bottomed out around $1,920 and then barely moved.
Copper was vulnerable to more weakness after last week's sharp losses, with $1,900/10 pegged as key support, some dealers said.
The other metals were little moved in late trade.
